name: BG2V
author: Calligula87
description: BG2V is a community-made PlayStation Vita port of Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition. It lets the game run on a homebrew-capable Vita with Vita controls, touchscreen support, and Vita-optimized startup videos.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
